name: contentvalidationreport
sql:
CREATE TABLE contentvalidationreport (
	sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	candidate_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	policy_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	candidate_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	report_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sha256)
)

name: contentreviewrecord
sql:
CREATE TABLE contentreviewrecord (
	sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	validation_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reviewer VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	review_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sha256), 
	FOREIGN KEY(validation_sha256) REFERENCES contentvalidationreport (sha256)
)

name: approvedcontentrelease
sql:
CREATE TABLE approvedcontentrelease (
	release_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	package_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	published_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (release_id)
)

name: contentreleaseentry
sql:
CREATE TABLE contentreleaseentry (
	release_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_revision_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	validation_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	review_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (release_id, curriculum_id, content_revision_id, topic_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(release_id) REFERENCES approvedcontentrelease (release_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(content_revision_id) REFERENCES contentrevision (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(validation_sha256) REFERENCES contentvalidationreport (sha256), 
	FOREIGN KEY(review_sha256) REFERENCES contentreviewrecord (sha256), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: contentreleaseevent
sql:
CREATE TABLE contentreleaseevent (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	release_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(release_id) REFERENCES approvedcontentrelease (release_id)
)

name: arenaattemptcontent
sql:
CREATE TABLE arenaattemptcontent (
	attempt_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_revision_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES arenaattempt (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(content_revision_id) REFERENCES contentrevision (id)
)
